'''June 2001 Mansfield tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Mansfield, Ohio on 16 June 2001. [[David Monteiro]] won it. It is known from David Monteiro's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2474">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-17-mansfield-ohio-6-16-01-numptiesd2474/ mansfield-ohio-6-16-01-numpties], DeckTech (David "JWRP119" Monteiro, 17 June 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-06-17-mansfield-ohio-6-16-01-numptiesd2474/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 June 2001
* '''Site:''' Mansfield, Ohio
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Tatooine]]
* '''Players:''' 11
* '''Winner:''' [[David Monteiro]]
